blocks.text: Our Brooklyn is an elegant, minimalist silhouette—with a distinctly New York attitude. Smaller than the 39, the hobo style is crafted of natural grain leather with beautiful texture and soft feel. Featuring a spacious interior with a snap pocket for access to essentials, the streamlined 28 has a comfortable, wide shoulder strap and an easy magnetic snap closure.

items.label: Editor's Notes
items.value: Our Brooklyn is an elegant, minimalist silhouette—with a distinctly New York attitude. Smaller than the 39, this hobo style is crafted of natural grain leather with beautiful texture and soft feel

items.label: Natural Grain Leather
items.value: A Natural Choice. Our semi-vegetable tanned Natural Grain Leather has a classic softly textured feel and unique character - for a perfectly classic Coach bag

items.label: On the Go Essentials
items.value: Featuring a spacious interior with a snap pocket for access to essentials, this streamlined womens shoulder bag has a comfortable, wide shoulder strap and an easy magnetic snap closure

items.label: It's All in the Details
items.value: Handle with 10.50 drop, Inside snap pocket, Magnetic snap closure, 11.0"L x 11.0"H x 3.75"W

items.label: This is COACH
items.value: Having the courage to be real since 1941. COACH is the Original American House of Leather - with a legacy of craft and a community that champions the courage to live authentically.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Spot clean with a damp cloth. Avoid water and direct sunlight. Machine washable for cotton parts, but dry clean for leather parts. Allow to dry naturally. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
